info.description:
Create and void shipment API. Same resource path /ship/v1/shipment; create is POST, void is PUT.


## Authentication


This API requires **Bearer Token** authentication. Include your token in the
`Authorization` header:


```

Authorization: Bearer <your-token>

```


All endpoints also require an `x-api-key` header.
info.title: Create Shipment

post.description: Create a courier outbound shipment, optional return shipment, or Returns Management (RMS) shipment. Freight is not supported.

requestBody.description: Provide all the information needed to create a shipment.

country.description: Must be US for US-origin shipments (not required for RMS).

postalZipCode.description: Canadian postal code, US ZIP code, or international postal code.

registeredAccountNumber.description: Registered (shipper) account number. Numeric, max 10 digits.

billingAccountNumber.description: Billing account number. Mandatory when paymentType is RECEIVER or THIRDPARTY. When paymentType is SENDER, if provided it must match registeredAccountNumber.

paymentType.description: Who pays for the shipment. Case-insensitive.

optionIdValue.description: Value for the option. Conditionally required depending on optionId. Typical values: true, false, Air, Ground, FullyRegulated, UN3373, UN1845, LessThan500kgExempt, LimitedQuantities. ExpressChequeAmount is numeric.
Value for the piece option. Conditionally required.

packageWeight.description: Weight of the piece in the selected unit of measure (kg or lb). Must be greater than 0.

packageLength.description: Length of the piece (in or cm). If any dimension is supplied, length, width, and height are all required. Not required for Express Pack/Box/Envelope services.

packageWidth.description: Width of the piece (in or cm).

packageHeight.description: Height of the piece (in or cm).

brokeragePackageNumber.description: Optional ICP brokerage package number. Generated when omitted for ICP shipments whose brokerage provider is not No Broker/Other.

costCenterReference.description: Optional. Alphanumeric only (A-Z, a-z, 0-9). No hyphens, spaces, or special characters. Max 20 characters.

name.description: Mandatory when notificationId is NotifyWhenExceptionOccurs, NotifyWhenDeliveryOccurs, ShipmentConfirmation-Requester, or ShipmentNotification-Receiver.

brokerageReferenceNumber.description: Optional ICP shipment-level brokerage billing reference. Alphanumeric, no control characters. Ignored when brokerage provider is No Broker/Other.

documentsOnlyIndicator.description: When true, omitted, or null, non-document and content details are not required and taxesPaid defaults to DDU. Must not be present on domestic (CA to CA) shipments.

currency.description: Optional. Only CAD or USD are permitted for ICP Northbound shipments.

printerFormat.description: Printer format. Optional for PNG/PDF/ZPL/DPL. Forced to NA for CODE128.

responseType.description: How document content is returned. Mandatory for some output types.

unitOfMeasurement.description: Imperial uses lb/in; metric uses kg/cm. Defaults to imperial if omitted.

totalWeight.description: Total shipment weight. Recalculated from packageInformation when that array is present.

totalPackages.description: Total number of pieces. Set from packageInformation length when that array is present.

internationalOrderNumber.description: ICP shipment-level international order number. Used when provided; otherwise generated for ICP shipments whose brokerage provider is not No Broker/Other.

serviceId.description: Return or RMS service. Includes dedicated return products PurolatorExpressReturn, PurolatorGroundReturn, PurolatorDeferredReturn.

brokerageVendorAddress.description: Mandatory for ICP when brokerage provider is not No Broker/Other. US and CA only.

brokerageExporterAddress.description: Optional ICP exporter address. US and CA only.

numberOfReturnShipments.description: Number of return shipments to generate. Min 1, max 100.

returnsManagement.description: When true, outbound is treated as an RMS (returns management) shipment and returnShipment is ignored.

validateOnly.description: When true, validates the request without creating a shipment or generating PINs.

returnRates.description: When true, include rate estimates in the response. 930-division accounts (Account Lookup SALES_DISTRICT 930) also receive estimates when this flag is false. The flag is stored as sent.

returnShipmentPIN.description: Present for outbound+return when returnsManagement is false.

internationalOrderNumber.description: International order number returned for ICP shipments when brokerage provider is not No Broker/Other.

brokeragePackageNumbers.description: Brokerage package numbers returned for ICP shipments when brokerage provider is not No Broker/Other.

packagePIN.description: Included only for CODE128 document entries.

data.description: Base64 document content when responseType is BASE64.

shipmentDocuments.description: Omitted when the response would exceed API Gateway size limits.

outboundShipmentEstimates.description: Present when returnRates is true, or when the outbound account sales district is 930.

returnShipmentEstimates.description: Present when returnRates is true, or when the return account sales district is 930.

shipmentPIN.description: PIN of the shipment to void. Also accepts shipmentPin.

bearerAuth.description: For secure access, this API uses Bearer Authentication (also known as token authentication). You must send a Bearer token in the Authorization header when making requests to protected endpoints. The token should be prefixed with the word "Bearer" followed by a space. Example: "Authorization: Bearer <YourTokenHere>".
